VERDICT: The declared prediction is FALSIFIED. Competition between features does not explain the gap between synthetic and real offsets: at real density the symmetric offset is 0.295 cells, slightly BELOW the quiet background's 0.370, against the record's 1.630.

what_the_prediction_said_and_what_happen.predicted_if_competition_explained_it: the symmetric offset rises toward the real 1.63 cells at density 7
what_the_prediction_said_and_what_happen.measured: 0.295 cells at the achieved density, against 0.370 on the quiet background -- it fell
what_the_prediction_said_and_what_happen.the_declaration_named_this_outcome: Neither asymmetry alone nor competition explains the real offset. The remaining candidates it listed are the shape of real incoherent structure, the non-Gaussian profile of a real cyclone, and a genuine physical difference between an 850 hPa vorticity maximum and an agency's surface centre.

what_density_DOES_cost.recovery: 167 of 247 plantings recovered. 80 were never recovered at all -- 32 per cent, against 8.8 per cent on the quiet background of T4E.20.
what_density_DOES_cost.spurious: 3 extracted features matched no planting across 39 frames.
what_density_DOES_cost.reading: Competition costs RECALL, not ACCURACY. Suppression removes the maximum that would have marked a centre; it does not displace the ones that survive. That separation was not predicted and is the substantive finding of this slice.

the_gate_passed_at_the_bottom_of_its_ban.achieved: median 4 features per frame against a declared band of [4, 10] and a record median of 7
the_gate_passed_at_the_bottom_of_its_ban.why_it_is_disclosed: The synthetic density is at the band's lower edge, so competition is under-represented relative to the record even though the gate passed. The band was declared before the measurement and is not moved now.
the_gate_passed_at_the_bottom_of_its_ban.what_that_permits_and_forbids: It forbids the claim that density has been tested at the record's own level. It permits the observation that going from 0 to 4 features per frame did not raise the offset at all -- it lowered it slightly -- which makes it implausible that 4 to 7 would triple it. That is an argument, not a proof, and is labelled as one.

what_remains_unexplained: About 1.3 cells, or 25 km, of the real 33.8 km offset. Neither the estimator's asymmetry bias at realistic parameters nor competition between features accounts for it. On this evidence the leading remaining candidate is that an 850 hPa relative-vorticity maximum and an agency's reported surface centre are not the same quantity -- which would make about 34 km an intrinsic cost of this comparison rather than an error to be fixed, and would make restating the T4E.18 acceptance against a defensible tolerance the correct response. That restatement is its own declaration and is not made here.
what_this_does_not_settle: That the offset is physical. T4E.19's storm-type test found no dependence on NATURE, which is evidence against a transition-driven separation, and this slice adds nothing to it.
That the extractor is sound. It is sound in this regime, on Gaussian vortices at the record's scales and amplitudes, at densities up to 4 per frame.
That N Gaussians on a randomised spectrum are a real vorticity field. They match on spectrum, density, scale and amplitude and not on the shape of incoherent structure.
Anything about cyclones, the catalogue, or any identity criterion.
